topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: I opened the attic door, and there they were—reminders of the lives once lived here. An old record player, its vinyls stacked beside it, gathering dust. A chest, bulging with forgotten quilts and trinkets. What were they thinking, leaving all this behind? Like they could just abandon their past and expect no one to notice. I haven't even properly settled in, and already, their shadows loom. I pull the ladder down with a bit more force than necessary, the hinges squeaking a protest. Why should I have to sort through their leftovers? This isn't what I signed up for.
